summary: FTC Solar filed an 8-K under Items 5.08 and 8.01 announcing that its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders will be held virtually on November 30, 2026, with a record date of October 7, 2026. Because the meeting is delayed more than 60 days from the 2025 annual meeting anniversary, the prior proxy's nomination deadline no longer applies; the company set an October 19, 2026 deadline for Rule 14a-8 proposals and other director nominations or business proposals. No transaction, stake, or price terms are present; this is a routine meeting-scheduling notice with no deal terms to arbitrage.
